result.summary: Independently re-verified against R-Co source directly (full re-read of service_scope_validator.zig, lines 109-224) rather than trusting either the prior FAIL or the rework's claim. (1) Plugin branch table (current §5) now has the nil-owner case as its own row: '{:ok, %{scope: :tenant, owner_tenant_id: nil}} -> Pass -- no violation', citing .zig line 187 (`const owner = reg.owner_tenant_id orelse return;`) -- confirmed line 187 is exactly that statement in the real file, and a bare `return` inside a `ServiceScopeError!void` fn is a successful return, matching the design's claim. The mismatched-owner row is now scoped 'non-nil' explicitly and cites .zig lines 188-200, confirmed accurate (line 200 is the `return ServiceScopeError.PluginNotAvailableToTenant;` statement; line 201 is only the closing brace). The two outcomes are no longer folded together. (2) Service branch table is byte-for-byte unchanged by the rework commit (confirmed via `git diff 820e7e8 679b129` -- zero lines touched in that table) and still correctly treats nil-owner_tenant_id as Violation (row 4), matching checkServiceId's `owner orelse { ...; return ServiceScopeError.ServiceNotAvailableToTenant; }` at .zig lines 142-151 (confirmed by direct re-read: line 142 is exactly that `orelse {` open, line 151 the closing `};`). (3) No regression found on any of the six previously-passed checks: hook contract fidelity re-confirmed directly against lib/letflow/definitions.ex -- @type service_scope_validator_fun (103-104), activate_opts (106-109), run_activate_transaction's :draft-only branch calling run_service_scope_validator (606-629, draft case 622), the nil-skip clause (631) and non-nil clause (633-645), interpret_activate_result's pass-through (679) -- all match the design's citations exactly, file untouched by the rework. All 5 REQ-031 acceptance criteria (docs/requirements.yaml lines 1461-1465) still map cleanly to §5's tables / §3.2's closed reason() union / §6 / §7, none of which the rework touched (confirmed via the commit diff: only §3.1's comment, §5's plugin table+prose, §8's INV-SSV-5/7/9, and §9's new OQ-4 changed -- 0/1/2/3.2/4/6/7/10/11 are byte-identical to the already-passed prior version). AC3's reason atoms unchanged (§3.2). AC5's moduledoc text unchanged (§7). No implementation code: still only defstruct/@enforce_keys/@type/@spec blocks in the two nested modules plus §7's plain prose moduledoc text -- zero def/defp bodies anywhere in the document, confirmed by re-reading the full file. graph.ex citations re-spot-checked directly and still accurate: Node @enforce_keys (line 79), Node.attributes type (line 86), Violation @enforce_keys (line 118-119), CHK-10 (579-592), CHK-11 (594). (4) New/changed citations verified individually: INV-SSV-9 cites '§5's plugin branch table, row 4' -- correct, that table's 4th row is the nil-owner-pass case. INV-SSV-7's citation fix from 'row 3' to 'row 4' is correct -- the service table's 4th row (not 3rd) is the nil-owner-violation case (row 1: not_registered, row 2: global, row 3: owner==tenant_id pass, row 4: nil-owner violation, row 5: mismatched-owner violation). OQ-4's text accurately restates the asymmetry, correctly notes (unlike OQ-3) no source document states a deliberate policy reason for it, and correctly flags it for REVIEWER/SECURITY-REVIEWER rather than silently resolving it either direction. All checks pass. Genuinely holds up -- PASS.
